explication: WooPayments is a WooCommerce payment gateway with customer checkout and merchant-facing payment administration. The client implements classic, block, and express checkout flows; the PHP side exposes payment and settings APIs and includes multi-currency support. Merchant screens also cover disputes, deposits, onboarding, and reporting. The graph preserves these major product areas, but unsampled paths are represented at their exact directory or file paths; relationships are omitted where the excerpts and source index do not establish them.
